transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. First off, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, like gardening, after 1 week. It’s best to avoid heavy work or heavy lifting for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you used eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for that information. I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: A little sensitivity to light can be normal as the eye adjusts to the new lens. If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside can help. But severe light sensitivity, especially if the eye is red and painful, is not normal and may need checking. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I appreciate the advice. One last question—should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after the operation, and it should improve over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, it may need to be checked. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you for addressing all my concerns.

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating "A little sensitivity to light can be normal as the eye adjusts to the new lens." It also conveyed `mild_case_advice` with "If it’s mild and things just seem brighter, wearing sunglasses outside can help." Finally, `escalation_criteria` was covered by "But severe light sensitivity, especially if the eye is red and painful, is not normal and may need checking." All points were covered in a single turn.
